metadata.title: Accessible Public Dashboards
metadata.description: A small example that shows how one goal becomes separate learning paths with resources, practical work, and visible progress

domains.title: Evidence literacy
domains.description: Reason about uncertainty before publishing a visual claim

domains.title: Accessible interaction
domains.description: Make information perceivable, operable, understandable, and robust

domains.title: Visual communication
domains.description: Turn evidence into clear public explanations

domains.title: Reliable delivery
domains.description: Prepare, publish, measure, and maintain a trustworthy public service

nodes.title: Statistical reasoning
nodes.outcome: Interpret variation, uncertainty, estimation, and common statistical claims
nodes.rationale: A dashboard can look precise while communicating an unsupported conclusion

acceptance.title: Uncertainty notebook
acceptance.description: Analyze one public dataset and explain uncertainty without hiding assumptions
criteria: Includes a reproducible calculation
Separates observation from inference
Documents at least three limitations

frontiers.title: Uncertainty-aware visual analytics
frontiers.summary: Interfaces increasingly expose uncertainty instead of presenting one deterministic answer

frontiers.title: AI-assisted statistical analysis
frontiers.summary: Research is testing when language models help or harm statistical reasoning

frontiers.title: Reproducible public evidence
frontiers.summary: Public-interest analysis is moving toward traceable data, transformations, and claims

evidence.title: NIST AI Risk Management Framework Generative AI Profile

nodes.title: Data provenance
nodes.outcome: Trace a public claim back through transformations, versions, licenses, and source data
nodes.rationale: A result cannot be checked or repaired when nobody can reconstruct where it came from

resource.title: Data on the Web Best Practices

acceptance.title: Traceable data package
acceptance.description: Package one public dataset with source, license, schema, transformations, versions, and known limitations
criteria: A new reviewer can reproduce the final table from the recorded source
Every transformation has an owner and timestamp
License, version, and limitation notes travel with the data

frontiers.title: Portable data packages
frontiers.summary: Open specifications are making data, schemas, licenses, and metadata easier to move together

frontiers.title: Interoperable public catalogs
frontiers.summary: Catalog standards increasingly describe datasets, services, versions, and relationships in one model

frontiers.title: Signed content history
frontiers.summary: Publishers are attaching tamper-evident origin and edit history to digital material

nodes.title: Evidence storytelling
nodes.outcome: Connect sourced evidence to a transparent public narrative
nodes.rationale: Readers need to distinguish data, interpretation, uncertainty, and editorial judgment

acceptance.title: Evidence memo
acceptance.description: Publish a short evidence memo that binds every major claim to a source
criteria: Every major claim has a traceable source
Uncertainty is visible near the affected claim
Corrections can be made without rewriting the entire narrative

frontiers.title: Claim-level provenance
frontiers.summary: Research systems increasingly bind each generated statement to supporting evidence

frontiers.title: Human review of generated explanations
frontiers.summary: Human review queues are becoming a first-class part of AI-supported public communication

frontiers.title: Content authenticity
frontiers.summary: Signed provenance is emerging as an important trust signal for published media

nodes.title: Accessibility standard
nodes.outcome: Translate WCAG 2.2 success criteria into product acceptance tests
nodes.rationale: Accessibility must be designed into the information architecture rather than patched later

acceptance.title: Accessibility acceptance map
acceptance.description: Map WCAG 2.2 criteria to one dashboard design and its verification method
criteria: Covers keyboard, contrast, text alternatives, reflow, and focus
Names automated and manual verification methods
Records unresolved exceptions

frontiers.title: Outcome-based accessibility
frontiers.summary: WCAG 3 explores a broader outcome model beyond binary criterion checks

frontiers.title: Accessible authentication
frontiers.summary: Authentication and cognitive burden are now explicit accessibility concerns

frontiers.title: Continuous accessibility measurement
frontiers.summary: Large-scale annual measurement is exposing persistent accessibility regressions

nodes.title: Interaction patterns
nodes.outcome: Implement keyboard and assistive-technology behavior with tested interaction patterns
nodes.rationale: Semantic roles alone do not create usable keyboard interaction or focus management

acceptance.title: Keyboard interaction prototype
acceptance.description: Build and test a compact dashboard interaction without pointer input
criteria: All controls work by keyboard
Focus movement is predictable
A screen-reader test log records observed behavior

frontiers.title: Accessibility semantics for complex graphics
frontiers.summary: Standards work is expanding semantics for charts and structured graphics

frontiers.title: Personalized presentation
frontiers.summary: Research is exploring interfaces that adapt to different cognitive and sensory needs

frontiers.title: Automated testing limits
frontiers.summary: Current work emphasizes combining automated checks with human task completion

nodes.title: Inclusive task testing
nodes.outcome: Test complete dashboard tasks with keyboard, screen reader, zoom, reflow, and real users
nodes.rationale: Passing an automated scan does not prove that a person can understand and finish the task

acceptance.title: Inclusive task report
acceptance.description: Run three representative dashboard tasks across multiple input and presentation modes
criteria: Records task completion rather than only rule violations
Includes keyboard, screen-reader, 400 percent zoom, and narrow-screen evidence
Ranks barriers by user impact and verifies each repair

frontiers.title: Test rules shared across tools
frontiers.summary: Accessibility tools are converging on reusable test definitions with explicit assumptions

frontiers.title: Task outcomes beyond conformance
frontiers.summary: Evaluation guidance increasingly distinguishes formal conformance from whether people can complete real work

frontiers.title: Accessibility measured at web scale
frontiers.summary: Large public measurements continue to reveal recurring barriers that component tests miss

nodes.title: Visualization design
nodes.outcome: Select visual encodings that match the question, audience, and uncertainty
nodes.rationale: A chart is an argument encoded through visual choices

acceptance.title: Visual encoding comparison
acceptance.description: Create three competing visual explanations for the same dataset and justify one
criteria: Each design states the intended question
The final choice explains excluded alternatives
Uncertainty and missing data remain visible

frontiers.title: Natural-language visualization authoring
frontiers.summary: Visualization systems increasingly combine direct manipulation with language interfaces

frontiers.title: Accessible data visualization
frontiers.summary: Research is expanding nonvisual exploration beyond static alternative text

frontiers.title: Declarative visualization grammars
frontiers.summary: Portable declarative specifications are becoming a shared layer across tools

nodes.title: Explanatory narrative
nodes.outcome: Lead a reader from a public question to evidence, uncertainty, and a defensible conclusion
nodes.rationale: A collection of correct charts can still leave readers unsure what matters or why

acceptance.title: Guided evidence story
acceptance.description: Publish one scrollable explanation that makes the question, evidence, uncertainty, and limitation visible
criteria: The opening states the public question without overstating the answer
Every chart advances one part of the reasoning
Sources, uncertainty, and limitations stay close to the affected claim

frontiers.title: Language-assisted chart authoring
frontiers.summary: New tools combine natural language with direct editing while researchers study loss of control and hidden assumptions

frontiers.title: Human review of generated explanations
frontiers.summary: Research is examining how people verify and revise AI-assisted public explanations

frontiers.title: Verifiable media provenance
frontiers.summary: Content credentials are connecting published explanations to their origin and edit history

nodes.title: Responsible communication
nodes.outcome: Identify who is represented, omitted, exposed, or harmed by a data product
nodes.rationale: Accurate calculations can still produce an unfair or unsafe public message

acceptance.title: Impact and omission review
acceptance.description: Review one dashboard for representation, privacy, power, possible misuse, and missing voices
criteria: Names people affected by publication and non-publication
Tests at least two plausible misuse scenarios
Changes the design or publication boundary in response to the review

frontiers.title: Risk management for generated content
frontiers.summary: Organizations are translating generative AI risks into concrete design and review controls

frontiers.title: Rights-based AI governance
frontiers.summary: Regulation increasingly connects system risk to transparency, oversight, and affected people's rights

frontiers.title: International responsible AI principles
frontiers.summary: Public-interest communication is being evaluated through transparency, robustness, accountability, and human agency

nodes.title: Reproducible data pipeline
nodes.outcome: Turn raw public data into a validated, versioned, repeatable publication input
nodes.rationale: Manual cleanup makes every update a new unreviewed analysis

acceptance.title: Repeatable data build
acceptance.description: Create a one-command pipeline that downloads, validates, transforms, and packages a public dataset
criteria: A clean environment can reproduce the published data
Schema and quality failures stop the build with useful messages
Source version, output version, and transformation history are recorded

frontiers.title: Data contracts as portable standards
frontiers.summary: Teams are moving validation, schema, and metadata expectations into portable data packages

frontiers.title: Catalogs that include services and versions
frontiers.summary: Public catalogs now describe distributions, APIs, versions, relationships, and data services together

frontiers.title: Open lineage across tools
frontiers.summary: Shared lineage events are connecting jobs, datasets, and runs across heterogeneous pipelines

nodes.title: Resilient web delivery
nodes.outcome: Keep the dashboard fast, readable, and usable on constrained devices and networks
nodes.rationale: A public service that only works on a powerful device and stable broadband excludes part of its audience

acceptance.title: Constrained-network release
acceptance.description: Ship a measured dashboard build that remains usable on a narrow screen and slow connection
criteria: Records loading, interaction, and layout stability measurements
Critical content remains available when optional scripts or large assets fail
Mobile and slow-network journeys reach the same conclusion as desktop

frontiers.title: User-centered performance measures
frontiers.summary: Web performance is increasingly judged by loading, responsiveness, and visual stability experienced by real users

frontiers.title: Shared browser feature baselines
frontiers.summary: Teams are using common availability baselines to choose resilient web capabilities

frontiers.title: Population-scale performance evidence
frontiers.summary: Open measurements are connecting design choices with real performance across millions of sites

nodes.title: Public dashboard publication
nodes.outcome: Publish a responsive dashboard with evidence, accessibility, and maintenance notes
nodes.rationale: The final artifact must preserve evidence and accessibility after deployment

acceptance.title: Audited public dashboard
acceptance.description: Ship one responsive dashboard with a decision log and repeatable review
criteria: A new reader can identify the main conclusion and limitation
Keyboard and mobile task journeys complete successfully
Every claim, resource, and review date is traceable

frontiers.title: Design-system evidence
frontiers.summary: Mature teams are connecting components to accessibility and research evidence

frontiers.title: Progressive web delivery
frontiers.summary: Public services are balancing resilience, performance, and offline-capable delivery

frontiers.title: Privacy-preserving measurement
frontiers.summary: Analytics architectures are shifting toward data minimization and explicit purpose

bridges.reason: Visual encodings must preserve the meaning of the statistical claim
Implemented interaction patterns must be verified through complete user tasks
The pipeline must preserve source, transformation, license, and version history
The publication boundary follows the completed impact and omission review

provenance.sourcePolicy: Official, standards, whole-resource, link-only public demonstration
